briefdescription.para: This function sends a command to ASUFW to generate an ML-DSA signature with the signing randomness rnd supplied by the caller instead of drawn from the TRNG, so that the ACVP hedged signature vectors can be driven through the module.

detaileddescription.para: Hedged signing draws rnd from an approved RBG, so only an ASUFW built with CAVP support serves this command; any other build rejects it as an invalid command. The secret key must be passed by address, as the key vault is not available to this command, and the Deterministic field is ignored because the supplied rnd decides the randomness outright.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XAsu_ClientParams structure which holds the client input parameters.
Pointer to the XAsu_MldsaSignDerandParams structure which holds the ML-DSA signature generation parameters and the rnd to sign with.
